T: One jump ahead of the bread line.
D: A street kid finds a magic lamp and a genie who grants him three wishes.
P: Serve the snacks when Aladdin steals the bread in the market.
S: the loaf Aladdin swipes and gives away
Yeasted dough rested an hour, rolled into rounds, cooked on a smoking hot pan until puffed and blistered, brushed with butter and za'atar.
Agrabah market hummus and smoky baba
the Agrabah market stalls Aladdin runs through

Silky hummus and charred eggplant baba ganoush, swirled with olive oil, sumac and pomegranate, with warm puffy flatbread to tear. Char 2 eggplants over a gas flame or under the grill for 15 minutes until collapsed, scoop out the flesh and mash with 2 tbsp tahini, garlic, lemon and salt. Blitz 2 drained 400g tins chickpeas with 80g tahini, the juice of 1 lemon, 1 garlic clove and 100ml iced water until silky. Top both with olive oil, sumac and pomegranate seeds. Serve with 4 warm flatbreads.
Medjool dates split, stuffed with a blend of cream cheese, orange zest and chopped pistachio, dusted with cinnamon.
M: a feast for the Sultan's table
Chicken thighs marinated overnight in yoghurt, garlic, cumin, coriander, turmeric and lemon, skewered, grilled over high heat until charred. Saffron rice, garlic sauce and pickles.
street food in the Agrabah market square

Spiced lamb kofta charred on skewers, with garlic yoghurt, chilli, herby tomato salad and pickled turnip, wrapped in warm flatbread. Mix 700g lamb mince with 1 grated onion, 2 garlic cloves, 2 tsp cumin, 1 tsp cinnamon, 2 tsp ground coriander, chopped parsley and salt. Shape onto 8 skewers and chill 30 minutes. Mix 200g Greek yoghurt with 1 crushed garlic clove and lemon. Dice 2 tomatoes, 1 cucumber and parsley. Grill the kofta on high for 8 to 10 minutes, turning. Wrap in 4 warm flatbreads with everything and pickled turnip.
W: the magic carpet ride over Agrabah

Crisp buttery filo layered with walnuts, pistachios and cinnamon, cut into diamonds and soaked in hot honey and orange blossom syrup. Mix 200g walnuts and 100g pistachios, chopped, with 1 tsp cinnamon and 50g sugar. Layer 12 sheets filo brushed with 150g butter with the nuts between. Cut into diamonds and bake at 170C for 45 minutes. Pour over 200g hot honey with 1 tbsp orange blossom water.
K: a blue genie, a green drink
Lemon juice blended with a big handful of mint, sugar syrup and ice until frothy, strained into glasses.

s.note: the loaf Aladdin swipes and gives away
s.how: Mix 300g flour, 7g yeast, 150g Greek yoghurt and 100ml warm water and rest an hour. Roll into 6 rounds and cook on a smoking pan until puffed and blistered. Brush with 50g butter mixed with 2 tbsp za'atar.
Split 12 medjool dates and remove the stones. Mix 100g cream cheese with orange zest and 40g chopped pistachios. Fill each date and dust with cinnamon.

m.note: a feast for the Sultan's table
m.how: Marinate 1kg chicken thighs overnight in 150g yoghurt, 3 garlic cloves, 1 tsp each cumin, coriander and turmeric and lemon juice. Skewer and grill hot until charred. Cook 300g basmati with a pinch of saffron. Serve with garlic sauce and pickles.

w.note: the magic carpet ride over Agrabah
w.how: Mix 200g walnuts and 100g pistachios, chopped, with 1 tsp cinnamon and 50g sugar. Layer 12 sheets filo brushed with 150g butter with the nuts between. Cut into diamonds and bake at 170C for 45 minutes. Pour over 200g hot honey with 1 tbsp orange blossom water.

d.note: a blue genie, a green drink
d.how: Blend the juice of 5 lemons with a big handful of mint, 120ml sugar syrup made from 120g sugar, 750ml cold water and 2 cups of ice until frothy. Strain into four glasses.
